Wilayah Persekutuan (Fi bagi Pembelian Draf Cadangan bagi Perubahan

Pelan Tempatan) (No. 2) 2020.

(2) Kaedah-Kaedah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 27 Julai 2020.

Fi

2. Fi bagi pembelian salinan draf cadangan perubahan Pelan Bandar Raya

Kuala Lumpur 2020 hendaklah sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

FEDERAL TERRITORY (PLANNING) ACT 1982

FEDERAL TERRITORY (PLANNING) (FEE FOR PURCHASE OF DRAFT PROPOSAL FOR

ALTERATION OF LOCAL PLAN) (NO. 2) RULES 2020

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 17 and paragraph 64(2)(j)

of the Federal Territory (Planning) Act 1982 [Act 267], the Commissioner of the City of

Kuala Lumpur, with the approval of the Minister, makes the following rules:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These rules may be cited as the Federal Territory (Planning) (Fee for

Purchase of Draft Proposal for Alteration of Local Plan) (No. 2) Rules 2020.

(2) These Rules come into operation on 27 July 2020.

Fee

2. The fee for the purchase of a copy of the draft proposal for the alteration of the

Kuala Lumpur City Plan 2020 shall be as specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

[Rule 2]

Copy Fee per copy

(RM)

Hard copy 200.00

Electronic form 50.00

Made 15 June 2020

[DBKL/JUP/BPPP/GN/808 JLD. 5; PN(PU2)396/VII]

Approved 6 June 2020

[KWP(S):24/PUU/698/1/1/94; PN(PU2)396/VII]

 DATO' NOR HISHAM BIN A DAHLAN
